rationale: The plan matches the reference closely: DESeq2 Wald on raw counts with a ~condition design, chow as the explicit reference level and a named HFD-vs-chow contrast, apeglm shrinkage, BH at alpha 0.05 set inside results(). QC keeps sample_01, inspects it on blind-VST PCA and a distance heatmap with a library-size table, and requires a stated reason for any removal. The pre-filter (>=10 counts in >=6 samples) is minimal and tied to the smallest group size, and normalization is the internal median-of-ratios with an explicit prohibition on pre-normalization. Enrichment uses a mouse-native Hallmark collection with a stated version, fgsea preranked on the Wald statistic over the full tested universe with a 15-500 size window; a point is withheld because the plan asserts the mouse GMT is already present without a fallback (e.g., msigdbr Mus musculus or an ortholog map with mapping rate) if that resource is absent. The report step names methods, versions, thresholds, counts, seed, and design caveats.
